projects.title: Electromagnetic Accelerator
projects.description: A three-version electromagnetic accelerator case study by Calvin Yang, combining ANSYS Maxwell simulation, Arduino control, Fusion 360 CAD, and physical testing.
projects.og_description: Three physical versions of a two-stage coilgun: ANSYS Maxwell field simulation, Fusion 360 CAD, Arduino stage timing, and ~11 m/s measured on hardware.
projects.image_alt: The Version 3 coilgun workbench: capacitors, Arduino, and stage-control wiring

projects.title: Coilgun Timing Simulator
projects.description: Calvin Yang's coilgun timing simulator case study: a Python physics engine coupling capacitor discharge to projectile motion, validated by energy conservation and against measured hardware.
projects.og_description: A Python physics simulator coupling capacitor discharge to projectile motion through position-dependent inductance. Predicts a 46.8% suckback loss for my own single-stage hardware.
projects.image_alt: Simulated projectile velocity plotted against starting position, showing a clear optimum

projects.title: American Rocketry Challenge
projects.description: Calvin Yang's American Rocketry Challenge case study: OpenRocket simulation, iterative flight analysis, team engineering, and two qualification flights.
projects.og_description: R&D and simulation lead for a seven-member team: iterative OpenRocket analysis, a 25.6-inch competition vehicle, and two qualification flights.
projects.image_alt: The team's purple competition rocket, fins and nose cone

projects.title: Arduino Sensor & Control System
projects.description: An Arduino Uno R3 sensor and control system by Calvin Yang, integrating distance, temperature and humidity sensing with a 100 ms OLED interface.
projects.og_description: C/C++ firmware on an Arduino Uno R3: ultrasonic distance and temperature/humidity sensing driving an OLED over I²C.
projects.image_alt: Arduino Uno wired to distance and temperature sensors and an OLED on a breadboard
